title: Weather Window
unit_story: Leo, Mia, Emma, and Toto look through the Weather Window. One day is sunny. One day is rainy. One day is windy. One day is cloudy. The team chooses simple clothes for each day. They help a friend and make a Weather Choice Card.

lessons.title: Meet the Weather
lessons.can_do: I can point to and say weather words.
lessons.kp: VOC: weather words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
lessons.study: Look at the weather window. Point to the weather. Say one word: sunny, rainy, windy, or cloudy.
lessons.your_turn: Point to one weather picture. Say the weather word.

lessons.title: It's Sunny / It's Rainy
lessons.can_do: I can say It's sunny and It's rainy.
lessons.kp: CHK: It's ...; VOC: sunny/rainy; RDG/LST: simple sentence recognition
lessons.study: Look outside. Use the chunk It's ... with sunny or rainy.
lessons.your_turn: Choose one window picture. Say: It's sunny. or It's rainy.

lessons.title: It's Windy / It's Cloudy
lessons.can_do: I can say It's windy and It's cloudy.
lessons.kp: CHK: It's ...; VOC: windy/cloudy; LST/RDG weather recognition
lessons.study: Look for moving leaves for windy. Look for many clouds for cloudy.
lessons.your_turn: Point to the window. Say: It's windy. or It's cloudy.

lessons.title: Clothes Basics
lessons.kp: VOC: clothes words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
lessons.study: Look at the clothes. Point and say one clothes word.
lessons.your_turn: Choose one clothes picture. Say the clothes word.

lessons.title: Choose Clothes
lessons.can_do: I can choose clothes for the weather.
lessons.kp: MED: choose for weather; CHK: Choose ...; VOC weather/clothes
lessons.study: Look at the weather. Choose one or two clothes items.
lessons.your_turn: Look at one weather picture. Choose clothes for it.

lessons.title: Help a Friend
lessons.can_do: I can help a friend choose clothes.
lessons.kp: SI/MED: help a friend; CHK: Choose ... for ...; review weather/clothes
lessons.study: A friend looks at the weather. Help with one short choice.
lessons.your_turn: Help Mia, Leo, or Emma. Say one short choice.

lessons.title: Project Rehearsal
lessons.can_do: I can make a simple weather choice card.
lessons.kp: PRJ: Weather Choice Card; SP/WRT: short project model; review It's ... + choose ...
lessons.study: A weather choice card has one weather picture and matching clothes pictures.
model: It's rainy. Choose boots. Choose an umbrella.
lessons.your_turn: Make your card. Say the weather and one clothes choice.

watch_lines: Mia sees the sun. It's sunny.
Toto watches leaves move. It's windy.
The team sees big clouds. It's cloudy.
Leo chooses a hat for a sunny day.
Mia chooses boots and an umbrella for a rainy day.
Emma chooses a sweater for a cloudy day.
The team helps a friend choose clothes.
Now it is your turn: make a Weather Choice Card.
